# Ayumitra

> Ayumitra is a free health companion app for the whole family, made by Kriti Rai (Kizmiz, Berlin). It keeps each person's lab reports, medicines, vaccines, appointments and phone and watch readings on the phone, reads reports from a photo or PDF, and answers questions in plain words, with the source of every answer. It is not a medical device: it doesn't diagnose, treat or give medicine doses.

Key facts, as of the pages linked below:

- **Price:** the app is free, and every feature works without paying. No account and no ads. No feature will ever be paywalled.
- **Ayumitra Pro (optional, from 15 December 2026):** a stronger AI answers, with nothing to set up and no key. €3.99 a month or €29.99 a year (prices for Germany, including VAT; the store shows the local price), with 7 days free for new subscribers. It's bought only inside the app, through Google Play or the App Store. There is one monthly allowance per account, about 650 questions, and web searches don't count. Zero data retention: after the answer, no server keeps what was sent.
- **Download:** Android, on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.ayumitra.ayumitra. iPhone and iPad: coming soon to the App Store. Available in the EU, India and the USA.
- **Devices:** the AI on the device needs an Android phone with 8 GB of memory, or an iPhone or iPad with 6 GB, and about 6 GB free. The model, about 2.6 GB, downloads once over Wi-Fi (or mobile data if chosen). On other devices everything else works, and answers can come from a cloud model with the person's own key.
- **Languages:** English, Hindi, German, French, Spanish and Dutch: screens, reminders and answers.
- **Privacy:** there's no account and no Ayumitra server holding health records. Records, photos and conversations are kept in an encrypted vault on the phone. Cloud AI (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or OpenRouter, with the person's own key) stays off until they agree and turn it on; family names are swapped for made-up ones first. Health Connect and Apple Health are read only.
- **Safety:** the app checks every question before and after the AI answers. Warning signs get an urgent-care card with the country's emergency number; thoughts of self-harm get the country's crisis line. Doses, and advice to start, stop or change a medicine, are taken out of answers. The checks lower the risk; they can't catch everything.
- **Contact:** support@ayumitra.app.

Each page below is also available as plain Markdown: add `.md` to its address, as in the links. Every page is in one file at https://ayumitra.app/llms-full.txt.

## Vaccination schedules

The childhood schedules Ayumitra follows, made from the app's own data, one page per country.

- [Vaccination schedules by country](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/index.md): the 25 countries
- [Vaccination schedule in India](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/india.md): IAP-ACVIP Recommended Immunization Schedule (2025), 0–18 years; Universal Immunization Programme: National Immunization Schedule
- [Vaccination schedule in Pakistan](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/pakistan.md): Expanded Programme on Immunization: routine schedule (Pakistan)
- [Vaccination schedule in Bangladesh](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/bangladesh.md): Expanded Programme on Immunization: routine schedule (Bangladesh)
- [Vaccination schedule in Sri Lanka](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/sri-lanka.md): National Immunization Programme: schedule (Sri Lanka)
- [Vaccination schedule in Nepal](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/nepal.md): National Immunization Programme: routine schedule (Nepal)
- [Vaccination schedule in Thailand](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/thailand.md): Thailand EPI
- [Vaccination schedule in Malaysia](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/malaysia.md): Malaysia NIP
- [Vaccination schedule in Singapore](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/singapore.md): Singapore NCIS
- [Vaccination schedule in Indonesia](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/indonesia.md): Indonesia: Imunisasi Rutin Lengkap (national programme)
- [Vaccination schedule in the Philippines](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/philippines.md): Philippines: National Immunization Program (DOH)
- [Vaccination schedule in Vietnam](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/vietnam.md): Vietnam: Chương trình Tiêm chủng mở rộng (EPI)
- [Vaccination schedule in Germany](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/germany.md): Germany STIKO
- [Vaccination schedule in Switzerland](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/switzerland.md): Switzerland BAG/EKIF
- [Vaccination schedule in the Netherlands](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/netherlands.md): Netherlands RVP
- [Vaccination schedule in Austria](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/austria.md): Austria Impfplan
- [Vaccination schedule in Belgium](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/belgium.md): Belgium SHC (CSS/HGR)
- [Vaccination schedule in Sweden](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/sweden.md): Barnvaccinationsprogrammet (Sweden): national childhood programme
- [Vaccination schedule in Norway](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/norway.md): Barnevaksinasjonsprogrammet (Norway): childhood immunisation programme
- [Vaccination schedule in Denmark](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/denmark.md): Børnevaccinationsprogrammet (Denmark): childhood vaccination programme
- [Vaccination schedule in Finland](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/finland.md): Kansallinen rokotusohjelma (Finland): national vaccination programme for children and adolescents
- [Vaccination schedule in the United Kingdom](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/united-kingdom.md): UK NHS
- [Vaccination schedule in France](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/france.md): Calendrier des vaccinations 2026 (France): enfants et adolescents
- [Vaccination schedule in Italy](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/italy.md): Calendario nazionale vaccinale, PNPV 2023–2025 (Italy): children and adolescents
- [Vaccination schedule in Spain](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/spain.md): Calendario común de vacunación e inmunización 2026 (Spain): children and adolescents
- [Vaccination schedule in the United States](https://ayumitra.app/vaccines/united-states.md): USA CDC
